user.title: Gym Tracker
user.description: Set up Gym Tracker. This creates the workout-tracking entities; there is nothing to configure. Select **Submit** to continue.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Gym Tracker is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

add_set.name: Add set
add_set.description: Record a set for an exercise using its current weight and reps inputs. Both must be greater than zero or the call is a no-op.

undo_last_set.name: Undo last set
undo_last_set.description: Remove the most recent set. Falls back to the last set of the most recent finished session if the current session is empty.

finish_exercise.name: Finish exercise
finish_exercise.description: Close out the current session, prepending it to history. No-op if the current session has no sets.
